item.title: Notes and Note workspaces
item.description:
Open Notes from the app rail or press Ctrl+Shift+N. On macOS, press Cmd+Shift+N. Notes fills the full window width. Choose Terminal in the Notes header to return to the terminal. Pressing Esc does not close Notes; Esc can still dismiss a Notes dialog or menu.

Notes keeps your Markdown in Note workspaces. A workspace is a named folder with a provider:

Provider Folder Free limit
Local Any folder on this computer 2
Obsidian An Obsidian vault (a folder with an .obsidian folder) 1
OneDrive A folder the OneDrive desktop app syncs, such as ~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Contoso/Notes or %UserProfile%\OneDrive\Notes 1
Google Drive A folder Google Drive for desktop syncs, such as ~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-you@example.com/My Drive/Notes or G:\My Drive\Notes 1

Each workspace is a tab across the top of Notes. The tab shows the provider’s logo and the workspace name; hover it to see the provider and the full folder path. The status line under an open note shows the same logo. Each workspace remembers its own open folder, note, filters, and view. The left sidebar stacks folders above the file list; drag its divider to resize it, or focus the divider and press the arrow keys. The sidebar width is remembered when you leave Notes.
